title: Literature benchmarks: grade B or TBD. None of these is a pass / fail gate until its primary data is pinned (sha256) in this folder.

cases.name: DFG flow around a cylinder, 2D-1 steady, Re 20 (Schäfer & Turek 1996)

definition.note: geometry and inflow from the FEATFLOW benchmark page as quoted by search extracts; run quasi-2D (one cell, periodic in z)

cases.provenance: cd 5.5795 quoted by FEATool docs (citing Nabh 1998, John & Matthies 2001); cd 5.5800 / cl 0.0107 quoted as the Turek reference by an LBM study (search extracts 2026-10-18). Primary FEATFLOW page not reachable from the sandbox.
cases.plannedAcceptance: cd within 3 %, cl sign and order of magnitude; gate after the FEATFLOW reference table is pinned
cases.status: TBD — pin FEATFLOW dfg_benchmark1_re20 reference values

cases.name: AIJ pedestrian-wind benchmark, single building 1:1:2 (case A)
cases.provenance: AIJ guidebook (Tominaga et al. 2008); case data said to be distributed through the AIJ / Open CAE Society of Japan (AIJ-PWEAB). Not downloaded.
cases.plannedAcceptance: speed ratio at 0.0125H above ground at the published measurement points; hit rate as defined in the AIJ guidebook
cases.status: TBD — download and pin the case A wind-tunnel data

cases.name: Lid-driven cavity, Re 100 and 1000 (Ghia, Ghia & Shin 1982, J. Comput. Phys. 48:387-411)
cases.provenance: Table I centreline velocities; values not read from a primary copy in this sandbox, so none are transcribed here.
cases.plannedAcceptance: u on the vertical centreline and v on the horizontal centreline within 2 % of the table range
cases.status: TBD — transcribe Table I from the paper and pin it

cases.name: Bow-shock stand-off distance on a sphere (Billig 1967)
cases.provenance: delta/R = 0.143 exp(3.24/M^2), gamma 1.4, as cited by arXiv 2604.00953; one secondary source

cases.name: ONERA M6 wing, Euler, Mach 0.8395, alpha 3.06 deg (Schmitt & Charpin, AGARD AR-138, 1979)

definition.note: Reynolds unused by Euler; conditions quoted by two secondary sources (11.72e6 vs 11.76e6)

cases.provenance: NASA NPARC Alliance validation archive hosts AR-138 Cp at 7 span stations (https://www.grc.nasa.gov/WWW/wind/valid/m6wing/m6wing.html), not reachable from the sandbox
cases.plannedAcceptance: shock position on stations 2-6 within 3 % chord; Cp within 0.05 away from the shock (Euler vs experiment, documented viscous bias)
cases.status: TBD — download and pin the NPARC Cp files
